text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Phew... haah...
Link—established.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "The coordinates Neo Universe and the others are aiming for... are all... the same..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
Great work! Neo Universe... right?
That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Ah... proactively... share.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe――"sought" it.
Interaction, resonance, in other words――synergy……

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... I have no idea what you're talking about,
but see ya!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Link... severed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“However... ‘reconnecting’ is possible.
The ‘password’... matches.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Neo Universe
made "contact".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Connection time is... 0.02.
But... it's very "METI".

"Neo Universe's report was esoteric.
However..."

"Connection time" is not counted in seconds, but as a unique sensory experience.
I can understand that... "METI" is an emotion akin to joy.

"And her running was truly remarkable.
Neo Universe possesses nearly flawless
qualities as an Umamusume."

For now, there are no weaknesses.
If I had to say anything...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This... "Doppler" is...

Her only weakness—is that she cannot speak normally.
However, as for whether that would be a major detriment to her racing career...
(Ooooohhh...)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: What was that cheering just now?
What was that cheer just now?

text_block_list.text:
A loud commotion echoed from the track.
Wondering what was going on, I stepped outside...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, Uni-san!
Did you see that just now...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There was an Umamusume who won in the most spectacular fashion.
That race was...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut, Turf 1800m...
The winning Umamusume is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that was a splendid Debut race.
Her pacing and race strategy were composed as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But the real challenge begins here.
Just how well can they perform at the top level?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Neo Universe.
That was a magnificent run earlier.
Congratulations on your debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ideally speaking, I would have loved to see a direct showdown.
With my "mother's beloved disciple" who just claimed victory.
choice_data_list: My beloved pupil... So the one who won the race was...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she's a student of my mother's. After retiring from active racing,
my mother runs a school where she teaches Umamusume how to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At the academy, I serve as an advisor in my mother's stead. The one who just won is one of the girls under my wing.

This Umamusume is Air Groove.
She's the student council vice president, known as "The Empress"
due to her uncompromising ideals and strength.

That apprentice was running in the 1800m race
that Neo Universe had originally planned to enter.
If they had faced each other...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If all had gone to plan... it should have been one day later.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "That" blocked "my" trajectory and moved ahead... Link—unestablished.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It was "inscribed"...
—the arrival of "ZDAL."

"ZDAL"... What those words
pointed to was the existence of a formidable rival.
"If we had run together... I might have been easily beaten."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She says she wants to pursue the Triple Tiara route.
I'm not sure if that's where her destiny lies, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Until we meet again, Neo Universe and
Trainer. Let us hone ourselves together.
And then—that night.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. "Make Debut" over.
After this, Neo Universe will—

First, let me apologize. As a Trainer,
my judgment this time was far too reactive...

Universe probably looked at the race roster, sensed danger,
and proposed switching races.

Yet I just vaguely accepted it.
Without truly understanding
the meaning or reason behind those words.

—A narrow brush with a formidable rival.
With only this level of understanding,
there's no way I can make it through what lies ahead...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to understand you even better.

text_block_list.text:
"Our compatibility should be fine.
However, we cannot become complacent.
We must learn to communicate even better."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is the same—
I want to understand."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I need to know you... more...
Either "SITL" or...

Neo Universe looks downcast as well.
She seems to regret not being able
to convey her thoughts properly.

—The contract has been forged. But our hearts
have yet to dock together. If so, then—
choice_data_list: Let's focus on “synchronization” for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Syn... chronization...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's come to understand each other through racing.
Yeah, let's come to understand each other through racing!

text_block_list.text: I'll talk with Neo Universe a lot. And I'll have her interact a lot with other Umamusume too.

"Let's let Neo Universe do what she wants,
while using this time to prepare for next year."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative, Trainer.
Neo Universe also... "agrees".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "MAZN" in a race—right?
"And so, our course of action was decided. We'll have her gain more race experience before the end of the year."
